Package index

Generate permutations

High-level functions for drawing one or more restricted permutations, or applying them directly to a vector.

shuffle() permute() permutator()
Unrestricted and restricted permutations
shuffleSet() as.matrix(<permutationMatrix>)
Generate a set of permutations from the specified design
permutations() print(<permutations>) as.matrix(<permutations>)
Permute a vector of data

Define and inspect permutation designs

Create permutation designs, count the possible permutations, and check designs for problems.

how() Within() Plots()
How to define a permutation design?
numPerms()
Number of possible permutations for a given object
check() summary(<check>)
Utility functions for permutation schemes

Complete enumeration and fixed-size partitions

Enumerate complete permutation sets or generate assignments to groups of fixed size.

allPerms() summary(<allPerms>) as.matrix(<allPerms>) as.allPerms()
Complete enumeration of all possible permutations
allPartitions() shufflePartition() shufflePartitionSet()
Generate random assignments to groups of fixed size
